comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Outsourced services provider paid a revenue share by universities; doesn't operate schools or collect tuition directly from students.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Operates nursing and allied health colleges like Rasmussen, but it's a small California-only campus operator, not an online or military business.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: For-profit, mostly online university operator funded by Title IV, with health sciences programs; same tuition-based model and adult students.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Operates online and campus universities for working adults, with military benefits and employer tuition programs; same tuition model.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Focuses on K-12 virtual schools funded by public school per-pupil payments, a different customer and funding model.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Campus-based vocational trades school with a different student base and programs, though also tuition and Title IV funded.
